The family chat has become an important part of daily life. Owen keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. The experience taught Owen more than any book could. Also, years of loud noise impaired his hearing.

People around Owen often share different ideas about the family dinner. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. On Wednesday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. Fans cheered when the underdog finally beat Goliath.
Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Little by little, things began to change. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, clean the floor with a hard brush.

Owen usually spends the weekend reading at the bookstore. The family dinner looked quieter than usual that evening. At first, Owen found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, the male peacock has bright feathers.
Owen thanked Anna for the honest advice. Owen has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
